lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 좌우명 적었어요? 한번 보여 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, did you write your motto? Can you show me?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, jwaumyeong jeogeosseoyo? Hanbeon boyeo jullaeyo?
lines.en: Yes, it's "Not taking on challenges is misfortune."

lines.beaver_en: That's a good meaning. Why did you choose it?
lines.en: In college I avoided challenges and regretted it.

lines.beaver_en: What lesson did you take from that?
lines.learner: 실천하지 않으면 앞길이 안 열린다는 교훈이요.
lines.en: That without action, the road ahead won't open.
lines.roman: Silcheonhaji aneumyeon apkkiri an yeollindaneun gyohuniyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then what are your values, Minsu?
lines.learner: 생명을 소중히 여기는 것과 정의를 지키는 거예요.
lines.en: Valuing life and standing up for justice.
lines.roman: Saengmyeongeul sojunghi yeogineun geotgwa jeonguireul jikineun geoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why do you think life is so important?
lines.learner: 작년에 사고가 났는데 겨우 목숨을 건졌어요.
lines.en: Last year I had an accident and barely survived.
lines.roman: Jangnyeone sagoga nanneunde gyeou moksumeul geonjeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? You must have been shocked.
lines.learner: 네, 그때 살아 있는 게 기적이라는 걸 깨달았어요.
lines.en: Yes, I realized that being alive is a miracle.
lines.roman: Ne, geuttae sara inneun ge gijeogiraneun geol kkaedarasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That's such a relief. You were lucky.
lines.learner: 재수도 좋았죠. 하지만 생존 자체가 교훈이었어요.
lines.en: I was lucky. But surviving itself was a lesson.
lines.roman: Jaesudo joatjyo. Hajiman saengjon jachega gyohunieosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 그럼 생각과 행동 중에 뭐가 더 중요해요?
lines.beaver_en: I see. Then which matters more, thoughts or actions?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureokunyo. Geureom saenggakgwa haengdong junge mwoga deo jungyohaeyo?
lines.learner: 저는 사상보다 실천이 더 중요하다고 봐요.
lines.en: I think practice matters more than ideas.
lines.roman: Jeoneun sasangboda silcheoni deo jungyohadago bwayo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 마지막으로 하나만 더 써 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Then will you write just one more?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom majimageuro hanaman deo sseo bollaeyo?
lines.en: "Truth lies in the soul, not the head." Like this.

lines.beaver_en: Wonderful. I look forward to your future, Minsu.
lines.learner: 감사합니다, 선배. 앞으로 더 실천하는 후배가 될게요.
lines.en: Thank you. From now on, I'll put things into action more.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida, seonbae. Apeuro deo silcheonhaneun hubaega doelgeyo.
